entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `CS0809` "Obsolete member overrides non-obsolete member" not always raised #78548
  • BoundCollectionExpression and related nodes may not be rewritten in lowering if well-known members are missing #78546

Closed

  • EnC: Emit array and UTF8 literals using FieldRva #69480
    .NET 10
  • Internal error in the C# compiler happens very frequently #76661
  • IntroduceVariableCodeRefactoringProvider error shows each time #77147
    Backlog
  • Exception in `IntroduceVariableCodeRefactoringProvider` when invoked on typecast #77559
    Backlog
  • Unable to cast object of type 'Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax.ParenthesizedExpressionSyntax' to type 'Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax.Simpl #78204
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10609.45 #78543

  • Add support for FieldRva to EnC delta #78033
    Area-Interactive, untriaged, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - String Literals in Data Section as UTF8, Next

    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Use pattern matching #78545
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Cancel running requests when the connection terminates #78525
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Cache extension method import info per project ID #78542
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

    Area-Infrastructure, untriaged

    Area-IDE, untriaged, VSCode
